source_refs.note: Exercise 5.1, Question 9: book page 85 (PDF 90); answer key book page 299 (PDF 304)

blocks.explanation:
Upar degree 2 aur neeche \((x + 2)^2\) bhi degree 2: improper fraction, aur neeche repeated linear factor.
Pehle divide karenge, phir remainder ko Case II se todenge.
Plan: division, identity, \(x = -2\) rakhna, coefficients compare, jor kar tasdeeq.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\frac{5x^2 - 2x + 3}{(x + 2)^2}\) (jaisa chhapa hai waisa hal kiya)
Maloom karna hai: is ke partial fractions.
Tareeqa: Improper hai, to fraction = quotient + proper hissa. Proper hisse mein \((x + 2)^2\) repeated factor hai: Case II, yani \((x + 2)\) aur \((x + 2)^2\) dono par fractions.

Divide karein
\[(x + 2)^2 = x^2 + 4x + 4\]
\[5(x^2 + 4x + 4) = 5x^2 + 20x + 20\]
\[(5x^2 - 2x + 3) - (5x^2 + 20x + 20)\]
\[= -22x - 17\]
\[\text{fraction} = 5 + \dfrac{-22x - 17}{(x + 2)^2}\]
Kyun: \(5x^2 \div x^2 = 5\). Remainder ki degree 1 hai jo 2 se kam hai, is liye division yahin khatam.
Dhyan dein: \(-2x - 20x = -22x\) aur \(3 - 20 = -17\).

Shakal aur identity likhein
\[\dfrac{-22x - 17}{(x + 2)^2} = \dfrac{A}{x + 2} + \dfrac{B}{(x + 2)^2}\]
\[-22x - 17 = A(x + 2) + B \quad (i)\]
Kyun: Power 2 wala repeated factor do fractions deta hai; \((x + 2)^2\) se multiply kar ke fractions hata diye.

\(B\) nikalein: (i) mein \(x = -2\) rakhein
\[44 - 17 = B\]
\[B = 27\]
Kyun: \(x + 2 = 0\), to \(A\) wala term khatam. \(-22(-2) = +44\).

Coefficients compare karein
\[x:\ A = -22\]
\[\text{const}:\ 2A + B = -44 + 27 = -17 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: (i) kholein to \(Ax + (2A + B)\) banta hai jo \(-22x - 17\) ke barabar hona chahiye. \(x\) ka coefficient seedha \(A\) de deta hai.

Jawab likhein
\[= 5 - \dfrac{22}{x + 2} + \dfrac{27}{(x + 2)^2}\]
Kyun: Quotient 5 aur do partial fractions. Quotient ko jawab mein likhna bhool jana is qisam ke sawalon ki sab se aam ghalti hai. Note karein ke 5, \(-22\), 27 wohi numbers hain jo \(5x^2 - 2x + 3\) ko \((x + 2)\) ki powers mein likhne se aate hain.

Tasdeeq: fractions wapas jor kar dekhein
\[= \dfrac{5(x + 2)^2 - 22(x + 2) + 27}{(x + 2)^2}\]
\[= \dfrac{5x^2 + 20x + 20 - 22x - 44 + 27}{(x + 2)^2}\]
\[= \dfrac{5x^2 - 2x + 3}{(x + 2)^2} \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Sab kuch \((x + 2)^2\) par le gaye aur asal fraction wapas mil gaya. Chhota number test bhi kar lein: \(x = 0\) par sawal \(\tfrac{3}{4}\) deta hai aur jawab \(5 - 11 + \tfrac{27}{4} = \tfrac{3}{4}\) deta hai. Dono barabar, to jawab pakka hai. Yahi test answer key ki ghalti bhi pakarta hai, jis ka zikr neeche hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Answer key \(\frac{5}{x + 2} - \frac{22}{(x + 2)^2} + \frac{27}{(x + 2)^3}\) deti hai. Yeh \(\frac{5x^2 - 2x + 3}{(x + 2)^3}\) (power 3) ka jawab hai, chhape hue \((x + 2)^2\) ka nahi: \(x = 0\) par key \(\frac{3}{8}\) deti hai jab ke chhapa hua sawal \(\frac{3}{4}\). Ya sawal ki power ghalat chhapi hai ya key. Chhape hue sawal ka jawab \(5 - \frac{22}{x + 2} + \frac{27}{(x + 2)^2}\) hai; dono mein \(5x^2 - 2x + 3 = 5(x + 2)^2 - 22(x + 2) + 27\) hi istemal hota hai.
